title: Sliders, a shorter Synth top, Loop and Song sides
thisBuild: Pick-one groups are sliders now: tap a stop or drag and let go. Synth kind, Simple/Full, Poly/Mono/Acid, the LFO wave, the pad filter's Lo/Hi/Band, Straight/Triplet/Dotted, Steps/Roll, and Loop/Song in the loop strip.
Synth's top is two short rows beside its pad: which synth and its preset, then the view and mode sliders.
The loop strip has a Loop side and a Song side. Click and Count are only as wide as their words; Song's keys say Play loop and Play song on one row.
The perform row is one short panel: keys in a row, the pitch wheel and the filter lying on their sides. The beat dot is gone.
Swipe up on Pack, Hold, Chords, Repeat or the key readout for their settings. Hold's settings are one bar: minus, the count, plus, Let go.
Gone: the Sample key (it is in the pad's Edit tray), the pack's zipper bar, the loop line on Steps and Roll, the loops row on Perform, and every explanation line.
Steps names sit level with their steps, the same height.
Look: bars and trays are one plate with a brass rule. A lamp's colour means one thing: yellow on, pink recording, oxblood takes sound away, teal a shape, amber readouts.
watch: Drag along the synth kinds and let go: does it feel right, or should it switch while you slide?
Swipe up on Pack and Hold: does the settings tray open every time, and the key not also toggle?
Do the sideways wheel and filter play better than the upright ones?
Any lamp colour that now reads wrong to you?
limits: Screen-based key sizing is a proposal for you to decide, not built yet.
Classic Look keeps its old colours; the colour meanings are for the panel Look.
